scenes.a: When an unknown future weighs on your mind.
scenes.sub: WHEN LEAVING ON A NEW PATH

scenes.a: Hear the promise of God in Genesis twelve:
And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
Lord, cover our household as we step forward in faith.
Let Your favor rest upon our children and protect our home.
Make our family a quiet light to everyone around us.
Amen, when an unknown future weighs on your mind.
